item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:40 PM 29 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Catanduanes(SanAndres, Virac, Bato), #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga, Labo, JosePanganiban, Paracale, SanVicente, SanLorenzoRuiz), #Romblon(SantaMaria, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Calatrava, Romblon, Magdiwang, Cajidiocan, SanFernando, Corcuera), #Sorsogon(PrietoDiaz, Casiguran, Irosin, SantaMagdalena, Juban, CityOfSorsogon, Matnog), #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Ragay, Lupi), #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay, Roxas and Bongabong) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sorsogon(Gubat, Barcelona, Bulusan), #Romblon(Looc, SantaFe, SanJose, Ferrol, Alcantara, Odiongan) and #NorthernSamar which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
